# Getting help

Start with the [installation guide](../docs/install.md),
[known browser/video limits](../docs/browser-video-analysis.md) and
[verification ledger](../docs/testing.md). This is source-only early alpha software;
building and signing for your own TV is required.

Use [Issues](https://github.com/DewXIT/isko-tizen/issues/new/choose) for setup questions,
reproducible bugs and feature proposals. Search existing reports first. English
and Polish are welcome. Include the commit/tag, relevant tool versions and short
steps; distinguish compilation, fixture behavior and observations on a real TV.

Never post certificate files/passwords, signed packages, local configuration, serial
numbers, pairing data, private network addresses, cookies or account details.
Use public origins or fixtures and redact screenshots/logs before sharing.
Do not attach raw device dumps. Maintainers do not need remote access to your network.

For vulnerabilities, use the [private security channel](../SECURITY.md).
Support is provided by volunteers, without a guaranteed response time.
